crew.overview: The cast of Friends reunites for a once-in-a-lifetime celebration of the hit series, an unforgettable evening filled with iconic memories, uncontrollable laughter, happy tears, and special guests.
crew.title: Friends: The Reunion

details.biography: Barbara Miller was an American casting executive who worked in the television industry for more than thirty years. Miller began her career at Warner Bros. in 1971 as an assistant in the casting department. She worked at CBS as a casting director before joining Lorimar Television in 1976 as the vice president of casting. The company was later merged with Warner Bros. television. In 1987, Miller was promoted to senior vice president of casting. She spent most of her career at Warner Bros. until her retirement in 2002.
details.name: Barbara Miller
